body:
HOLD on exact 067e35b, from the bytes; I did not rerun its gate.

1. The vehicle breaks an existing lawful producer before the routing candidate. Resolution.scala now refuses nonzero excluded with empty excludedBy. But TraditionalScoring.placementResolution in scoring/Scoring.scala still accumulates nonzero excluded for RepetitionRule.Ignore, calls PlacementResolution.of(... excluded / total) with no excludedBy, and folds Left by throwing IllegalStateException. The existing InterviewSuite Ignore court exercises categoryDistribution only, not TraditionalScoring.score, so 96 green misses this production exception. This contradicts the candidate claim that it moves nothing. Before landing, migrate that existing producer to RepetitionPolicy attribution and add an end-to-end score court whose old/no-attribution mutation fails.

2. BelowMembership names a rule family but does not record the threshold that failed. The in-force 0.5 remains a private Scoring.scala constant and is absent from PlacementResolution identity/render. Chief required WHICH threshold each exclusion failed; two persisted BelowMembership summaries built under different future cutoffs would remain indistinguishable. Carry a validated membership-threshold value (or another injective threshold identity that preserves its value) in the cause/evidence, and add a court showing different cutoff values remain unequal and visibly attributable. The next routing candidate should pass the exact MembershipThreshold in force.

The mass-accounting invariants and hand-written equals/hash include all present fields; I found no separate issue there. The blocker is producer completeness plus loss of the actual threshold provenance.
